failedAssertions.reason: The horizontal summary stat cards have the required warm card styling and 22px/700 values, but they do not render the required per-card trend arrows; trend icons appear only later in the separate Performance Score section.
The screen does not implement a pill-style Pending/Completed segmented toggle; instead it renders three pending sections plus a separate collapsible completed section.
The outer shell matches the mist-2 pill with 3px padding, but the active segment itself uses mist-1 (#F7F3ED) instead of white and Android selected labels stay at medium weight instead of 600.
The mark-attendance view now has per-worker pill toggles with the correct green/amber/red fills, but the controls do not include the matching dot indicators required by the contract.
The sticky primary CTA is present and full width, but it uses borderRadius.md (16px) instead of the required 12px radius.
Spray catalog cards have the required 3px green strip, PHI info, and border-only shell, but the screen never renders the required type badge or any amber warning banner path.

appliedUpdates.description: Added Flow Validator Guidance: cli to document validation-only command boundaries and the known web:smoke react-native-maps exception for future runs.
